Ajax.name: Míchel
Ajax.bio_ko:
In Spain, Míchel is a common nickname for Miguel, particularly frequent in footballers. Spanish footballers known as Míchel include:Míchel, real name José Miguel González Martín del Campo, former Spanish football midfielder and coach, and allegedly the one who popularized the nickname
Míchel, real name Miguel Ángel Sánchez Muñoz, Spanish former football midfielder
Míchel, real name Miguel Ángel Carrilero, Spanish former football forward
Míchel, real name Miguel Marcos Madera, Spanish football midfielder
Míchel, Miguel Alfonso Herrero, Spanish football midfielder
Michel, Michel Costa da Silva, Brazilian football midfielder
Míchel Salgado, real name Miguel Ángel Salgado Fernández, Spanish former football defender
Míchel Zabaco, real name Miguel Zabaco Tomé, Spanish football defender
Carlos Michel Lopes Vargas, known as just Michel, Brazilian footballer

NAC Breda.name: Carl Hoefkens
NAC Breda.bio_ko: Carl Hoefkens is a Belgian football manager and former professional footballer who played as a defender. He is currently the manager of Eredivisie club NAC Breda.

Heracles Almelo.name: Ernest Faber
Heracles Almelo.bio_ko: Ernest Anthonius Jacobus Faber is a Dutch professional football manager and former player who is the head coach and technical director of Eerste Divisie club Heracles Almelo.

Telstar.name: Henk Brugge
Telstar.tactics_ko: A 2026 profile described him as favouring a 4-3-3 formation with an attacking midfielder . On his appointment at Telstar he said he intended to build on the attacking football that had brought the club praise under Correia .

Twente.name: John van den Brom
Twente.bio_ko: Joseph Anthonius John van den Brom is a Dutch professional football manager and former player who is currently the manager of Eredivisie side Twente.

PSV.name: Peter Bosz
PSV.bio_ko: 페터르 실베스터 보스(네덜란드어: Peter Sylvester Bosz ˈpeːtər ˈbɔs [*], 1963년 11월 21일 ~ )는 네덜란드의 전 축구 선수이자 축구 감독이다.
PSV.tactics_ko: Bosz favours an attacking style of play, based on ball possession and aggressive pressing. Furthermore, Bosz's tactical ideas are heavily influenced by the football of Johan Cruyff .

Sparta R..name: Rogier Meijer
Sparta R..bio_ko: Rogier Meijer is a Dutch professional football coach and former player. He is the head coach of Eredivisie club Sparta Rotterdam.

Go Ahead Eagles.name: Joseph Oosting
Go Ahead Eagles.bio_ko: Joseph Oosting is a Dutch football manager and former player, who is currently head coach at Eredivisie club Go Ahead Eagles.

Excelsior.name: Ruben den Uil
Excelsior.bio_ko: Ruben den Uil is a Dutch professional football manager who manages Eredivisie club Excelsior.

Groningen.name: Dick Lukkien
Groningen.bio_ko: Dick Lukkien is a Dutch football manager and former footballer currently in charge of Eredivisie club FC Groningen.

Heerenveen.name: Robin Veldman
Heerenveen.bio_ko: Robin Veldman is a Dutch football manager who is the manager of SC Heerenveen in the Eredivisie.

Volendam.name: Rick Kruys
Volendam.bio_ko: Rick Kruys is a Dutch professional football manager and former player. His father, Gert Kruys is also a former professional footballer and current manager.

Feyenoord.name: Giovanni van Bronckhorst
Feyenoord.bio_ko: 지오바니 판브롱크호르스트(네덜란드어: Giovanni Chiristiaan van Bronckhorst, 1975년 2월 5일 ~ )는 은퇴한 네덜란드의 축구 선수이자 최근 네덜란드의 에레디비시 페예노르트의 축구 감독을 맡고있다.

Fortuna Sittard.name: Danny Buijs
Fortuna Sittard.bio_ko: Danny Buijs is a Dutch professional football manager and former player. He is the head coach of Eredivisie club Fortuna Sittard in the Netherlands.

Zwolle.name: Henry van der Vegt
Zwolle.bio_ko: Henry van der Vegt is a Dutch football coach and former player who is head coach at PEC Zwolle.

NEC Nijmegen.name: Dick Schreuder
NEC Nijmegen.bio_ko: Jan-Dirk "Dick" Schreuder is a Dutch professional football manager and former player who played as a midfielder. He is the head coach of Eredivisie club NEC.

Utrecht.bio_ko:
